summary:
AstroCare is a health monitoring and decision-support application designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. Spaceflight conditions such as altered gravity, isolation, radiation exposure, and disrupted sleep can affect an astronaut's physical and behavioral health.

AstroCare brings important health indicators into a single dashboard, including heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂), body temperature, sleep duration, and self-reported mental wellness. It presents health trends through interactive visualizations and helps astronauts identify unusual changes through warning indicators and personalized health monitoring.

The application aims to help astronauts become more aware of their health, recognize potential concerns early, and make informed decisions about seeking appropriate support. By combining physical health tracking, wellness check-ins, and trend analysis within an accessible software platform, AstroCare supports the goal of safer, more self-reliant long-duration human space exploration.
details:
Project Overview

AstroCare is an astronaut health monitoring and decision-support application designed for long-duration space missions. It provides a centralized platform to monitor physical health indicators, track mental wellness, and observe changes in health patterns over time.

How It Works

The application collects or accepts health indicators such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂), body temperature, sleep duration, and self-reported stress and mood levels.

These indicators are displayed through an interactive dashboard. Historical readings are visualized using graphs to help identify changes from an individual's usual health patterns. The system also provides warning indicators when configured conditions require attention and generates downloadable health reports.

The initial prototype uses simulated health readings to demonstrate the monitoring workflow. It is designed to support future integration with wearable sensors and real astronaut health datasets.

Key Features

  • Physical health indicator monitoring.
  • Sleep and mental wellness check-ins.
  • Interactive health trend visualization.
  • Personal health baseline comparison (planned enhancement).
  • Warning and decision-support indicators.
  • Downloadable health reports.

Technologies Used

Python is used for application development, Streamlit for the interactive interface, Pandas and NumPy for data handling and processing, and Plotly for data visualization.

Creativity and Innovation

AstroCare combines physical health monitoring, behavioral wellness tracking, and historical trend visualization in a single application. Rather than displaying isolated measurements alone, the intended approach focuses on helping astronauts understand changes in their health over time and take appropriate action.

Intended Impact

AstroCare aims to improve astronaut awareness of physical and behavioral health changes, support early identification of potential concerns, and encourage informed self-monitoring during long-duration missions where immediate access to medical assistance may be limited.

The application is a prototype and is not intended to replace professional medical diagnosis or emergency medical support.
